name: mc_repair
title: Targeted build repairs
description:
Repairs only mismatching cells: from a fresh mc_verify comparison (then rechecks the whole expectation and returns a new comparisonId), or from an mc_diff receipt (writes the reference states of its differing cells; run mc_diff again to recheck). Never replays the original build.

WHEN TO USE: in an opt-in exact-verification workflow after mc_verify check, or after an mc_diff that found differences; review the positions first. Do not create a receipt only to fix a small visually identified defect.
WHEN NOT TO USE: broad rebuilds, flowing-fluid plans (they cannot be auto-repaired), inventory or NBT restoration, concurrent transactional editing.

PARAMETERS: planId plus comparisonId from the latest check, or diffId (not both; limit applies to planId only). positions selects explicit mismatches (default all). maxChanges 1-10000 (default 1000) rejects larger selections. snapshot defaults true (the selected cells' envelope). allowBlockEntityReplacement defaults false, protecting existing signs, chests and other block entities; same-material state repairs keep their data. Placement-mode repairs keep excluded live properties. Selected cells in a protected deny region reject the call unless named in override.

SIDE EFFECTS: writes the selected block states (no physics, connection pass or neighbour refresh) and supported sign values (never for diffId); matching and untouched cells are never written. Every selected cell is rechecked before the first write and late edits are skipped; no atomic lock. Snapshots hold block states, sign text and decorative entities, not inventories. Use the returned comparisonId for further repairs.

override.description: Protected region names this call may write into anyway; no wildcards. Only when the user explicitly asks.
